items.title: Andre Drummond grabbed his 4,000th career offensive rebound in the New York Knicks’ 111-102 win over the Toronto Raptors.
items.author: NBA Stat
items.body_excerpt:
Andre Drummond grabbed his 4,000th career offensive rebound in the New York Knicks’ 111-102 win over the Toronto Raptors.

He’s just the 10th player to reach that mark since the NBA began tracking the statistic in 1973-74.

#NBA
